_provenance: X API v2 GET /2/tweets?ids=111,222 batch lookup with the tweet.fields/expansions/user.fields/media.fields set the T-121 endpoint sends. Post 111 carries a photo attachment; post 222 both replies to 111 and quotes 333 (both present in includes.tweets so their authors resolve). Shapes verbatim from docs.x.com/x-api/data-dictionary. Captured 2026-07-23. Exercises: REND-1 @handle authors, metric mapping, REND-4 permalink, reply/quote refs, media compaction. NOTE: the ids-lookup endpoint does not truly return a `meta` block; it is included per the T-121 brief and is ignored by renderPosts.
